notes: Shares rate page index_hendo_choice_21 (param hendo_choice_21_02) with プレミアハーベスト (189); the hub labels the page 'プレミアジャーニー・プレミアハーベスト'. 安心道しるべ (188) links to the same page with ?product=188; the history table fetched with product=188 is byte-identical to the one without, so it is recorded as an edition. History from 2021-09-01. USD and JPY only.

Product type indexed_annuity (changed from fixed_annuity on 2026-11-17). The saved brochure (brochure_PremierJourney_hanyo, sources/dfl/docs/) shows the (21) form is index-linked: at the end of the 積立利率保証期間 the 年金原資額 is the 基本移行原資額 (fixed by the contract-date 積立利率, never below 100% of the premium) plus an 指数連動移行原資額 = premium x rise of the 参照指数 since the 基準日 x 連動率 (zero if the index has not risen). The rate page publishes only the 積立利率 by currency and 5/10-year guarantee period, which is what the CSVs hold; the 連動率 and index values are not collected.
The distributors list is the 銀行・信用金庫・信用組合・証券 section of the product page.

Launch date not established (left null): the insurer's release index 2008-2026 (read 2026-11-17) contains no release for 『プレミアジャーニー』. Its formal name 積立利率変動型個人年金保険（21）（通貨指定型）is shared with 『安心道しるべ』 (Resona, from 2021-09-01, release id=991, snapshot sources/dfl/pages/release_991_2026-11-17.pdf), but that is a different marketed name and is not taken as this product's date.

Launch date search 2026-11-17 (second pass): DFL release lists 2019-2026 (titles) and the bodies of saved release PDFs ids 989-1083; two web searches for プレミアジャーニー 発売 / 取扱開始, including bank and shinkin notices. Nothing names プレミアジャーニー; still null.
notes_en: Rate history starts on 1 September 2021 and covers USD and JPY with 5 and 10-year guarantee periods.
Premier Harvest and Anshin Michishirube share the same rates and are treated as editions.

Classed as an indexed annuity: per the brochure, at the end of the guarantee period a fixed amount of at least the premium is topped up by the rise in a reference index. The published rate is the fixed crediting rate; the index participation is not collected.
Launch date not established; the history start may be later than the launch.

verification.method: An independent parser (scripts/recheck_candidates_a.py, not the collector's) compared 124 rows with their saved snapshots and all matched: a seeded random sample of 100 of 988 published rows (10% of each rate CSV, at least 20), every outlier (4: a value more than 3 standard deviations from its series mean, a move of more than 1pp between consecutive periods, or a value outside 0-15%; 10pp and 0-300% for participation rates) and every not_offered row (20). A follow-up pass over every row also matched.
